notes: Topline: building a low-latency RAG search for portfolio analytics and compliance — must keep EU/UK residency.
Scale: targeting 15-25M indexed docs in year 1; embeddings store ~768-d vectors, expect ~2-3TB raw vector store
Latency targets: p95 query latency < 50ms for nearest-neighbor + reranker 1-2x round-trip; overall end-to-end p95 < 120ms
Throughput: baseline 200 qps, burst to 1k qps during end-of-day analytics windows
Cost sensitivity: want cost-per-query under €0.02 for steady-state; willing to pay premium for EU-hosted dedicated nodes
Model preferences: open-embedding models and lightweight reranker (fine-tuned ELECTRA/DistilBERT). Evaluate both quantized and fp16 variants.
Routing needs: geo-routing between EU regions (FR/LON/DE) with automatic failover to secondary region — must not cross data residency boundaries for cached documents.
Security: mandatory SSO (SAML), KMS integration for keys, audit logging of prompt/query texts (redaction options needed), 7-year retention controls for compliance team.
Quote: 'We cannot accept a vendor that routes user data outside UK/EU without explicit contract clause' — Saffron CTO (paraphrase).
Proof-of-value ask: run a 2-week latency POC with dedicated EU nodes, measure p95 and cost per qps, provide reranker accuracy (MRR/NDCG) vs baseline.
Docs shared: pricing deck + candidate architecture in Drive, security FAQ, sample ingestion script in repo.
SE notes: initial embedding vector dims and index choice will materially affect cost; suggested hybrid index + on-disk quantized vectors for scale.
Next technical ask: recommend autoscaling policy for dedicated pools that maintain <50ms p95 under burst while minimizing idle GPU hours.
